decks.notes: This deck revolves around using Kaalia of the Vast to cheat powerful creatures into play quickly and overwhelm the opponent. It includes a mix of high-impact creatures like Griselbrand and Master of Cruelties, along with support cards to protect Kaalia and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes combo pieces like Worldgorger Dragon and Animate Dead for explosive plays. With a mix of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and combo potential, the goal is to take control of the game early and close it out before the opponent can mount a defense. The deck is designed to be proactive and efficient, aiming to win quickly and decisively.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw effects to disrupt the opponent's strategies and maintain board control. The mana base is built to ensure consistent access to multiple colors, allowing for flexibility in casting spells. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Oko, Thief of Crowns provides additional control tools and win conditions. Additionally, cards like Rest in Peace and Toxic Deluge serve as ways to handle graveyard strategies and wide board states effectively. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on utilizing the aggressive abilities of Raph & Mikey, the Troublemakers commander to quickly overwhelm the opponent in a Duel Commander 1 vs 1 format. The deck includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production, as well as powerful spells such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Worldspine Wurm to deliver devastating blows. The deck also features a mix of protective spells like Veil of Summer and Jeska's Will, as well as mana acceleration through cards like Geosurge and Pyretic Ritual. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy, utilizing the unique abilities of Raph & Mikey to outpace and overpower the opponent in combat.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble as many artifacts as possible in order to generate mana and control the board. The Fantasticar commander provides additional support for artifacts and can accelerate the deck's strategy. By utilizing various mana rocks and utility artifacts, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents with a wide array of options and threats. The inclusion of powerful artifacts such as Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Mystic Forge helps provide card advantage and allow for explosive plays. Overall, the key strategy is to leverage the synergies between artifacts to create a proactive and resilient aggro deck that can quickly close out games through a combination of aggression and resource management.

The deck revolves around utilizing Emry, Lurker of the Loch's ability to cast artifacts from the graveyard to assemble powerful combos and control the board. The deck includes a wide range of cheap artifacts to feed Emry's ability, as well as key pieces like Urza, Lord High Artificer and Paradox Engine to generate infinite mana and card draw. It also includes disruptive elements like Ensnaring Bridge and Tangle Wire to protect the combo pieces and slow down opponents. The deck aims to quickly establish a strong board presence, control the game with disruptive spells, and ultimately win through a combo finish or overwhelming advantage.

This aggressive deck aims to quickly deploy creatures onto the battlefield and utilize a combination of efficient removal spells and disruption to control the game. By utilizing Juri, Master of the Revue as the commander, the deck can quickly build up a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of powerful creatures with abilities that can further enhance the aggression, along with versatile removal spells to deal with threats. With a strong mana base and a mix of creatures and spells that work well together, this deck is designed to overwhelm opponents and secure victory through a combination of speed, aggression, and disruption.

The deck focuses on utilizing a high number of instants and sorceries to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also generating card advantage and mana efficiency. The commander, Lier, Disciple of the Drowned, serves as a valuable source of recursion for key spells. The deck includes various counterspells, card draw spells, and mana manipulation cards to keep the opponent on the back foot and maintain tempo. By maintaining a tight grip on the flow of the game and overwhelming the opponent with efficient spells, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. The key to success lies in carefully managing resources and outpacing the opponent's threats.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures and versatile spells to maintain board control and pressure opponents. The key concept revolves around establishing early aggression with a variety of aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers, Chaos Defiler, and Spider-Punk. These threats are complemented by removal spells such as Swords to Plowshares, Dismember, and Abrupt Decay to deal with opposing threats efficiently. This aggressive strategy is further supported by disruptive cards like Drannith Magistrate and Opposition Agent to disrupt opponent's game plan. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt opponent's strategy, and maintain control of the board to secure victory in a fast-paced 1 vs 1 format.
